title: The Day the Compass Spun
skyStory: The moon has slipped out of Scorpio and into Sagittarius, which means it packed a bag, forgot its toothbrush, and is now humming on the highway. Sagittarius wants adventure. It is January in Atlantic Canada. Adventure will have to mean a new route to work, a different mug, a fresh playlist. Saturn approves of the mug.

reading: First real Monday of the year, and your inbox has been breeding over the holidays. Mars is side-eyeing it with real menace. Do not attack it all at once. The [[Knight of Wands]] says aim the fire at one thread, finish it, and let the rest watch you do it.

Take a different route somewhere today, even if it is only the long way to the kitchen. Sagittarius rewards novelty, and around 1:30 pm the new path will show you something small and funny: a snowman in a traffic cone hat, or a sign with a typo so good you have to photograph it.
joel.mission: Take a route you have never taken to any destination today, and name it after yourself.
joel.omen: A snowman with an unusual accessory. It means a creative idea is coming from an unexpected direction this week.
joel.stoneWhy: calm water for a busy inbox

reading: Sagittarius sends you an arrow this morning, and it lands on a question you have been carrying around since autumn. You do not have to answer it today. You only have to say it out loud to someone you trust, and watch it get smaller in the light.

Your Life Path 11 hum is turned up today. At least twice you will know what someone is going to say a second before they say it. Do not spook them by finishing their sentences. Just smile the Wood Rat smile and let them have their moment. Later, doodle the [[Ace of Wands]] on a sticky note, because something is about to start.
nancy.mission: Say your autumn question out loud to one trusted person, then ask them for theirs.
nancy.omen: An arrow drawn in frost on a car window. It means you are pointed exactly the right way.

together.text: Pick one shared goal for January, small enough to fit on a sticky note. Write it on two notes, one each, and stick them somewhere you will see daily. Saturn will check in on the fifteenth. Mars will check in every eleven minutes. Ignore Mars.

game.intro: The compass is spinning, the moon is in Sagittarius, and you have ten seconds per choice. No dithering, Tiger.
